hook.name: KingOfTheHillHook
hook.description: A gamified hook where the largest ETH buyer earns the "King" title and collects 2% fees on all buys. Sells incur a 1% KOTH token burn. Dethroned kings have ~12 hours to claim earnings before a keeper can forfeit them into a buyback-and-burn of KOTH. Scroll NFT discounts can reduce the ETH threshold required to dethrone the current king.
